segs.vis: Nova 揮手 P02，名牌在臉旁
segs.text: Hi, class! I'm Ms. Nova.

segs.vis: Cosmo 揮手 P02，名牌在臉旁
segs.text: And I'm Mr. Cosmo! Welcome back to our space classroom!
Look! We have ten new friends from around the world!
Today, we will learn to ask: Is she from India? Is he from Japan?
今天要學怎麼問「她是從印度來的嗎？」，還有怎麼回答「是」或「不是」。
First, let's learn ten countries.
先來認識十個國家。看國旗、看地標，跟著唸。
Repeat after me.
Australia.

cap；四張國名卡 Australia India Japan Singapore；第一個字母發光
segs.text: Look at the first letters. A, I, J, S!

segs.vis: cap；四張國名卡；大寫字母放大
segs.text: 國家名字的第一個字母一定要大寫。

segs.vis: the；card:the UK / the USA；the 發光
segs.text: Now look. The UK. The USA. We say the!

segs.vis: the；card:the USA = the United States of America
segs.text: 英國和美國前面要加 the。the USA 是 the United States of America，美利堅合眾國。
the UK 是 the United Kingdom，「聯合王國」，也就是英國。
Let's say all ten countries together!

segs.vis: world；接力，唸到誰亮誰（國旗＋國名）
segs.text: Australia, India, Japan, Singapore, Spain, Taiwan, the UK, the USA, Korea, Vietnam!
This is Raj. He is from India.

segs.vis: kid:Raj；card:He is from India.；he；from 發光；中文 他來自印度。
segs.text: from 是「來自」。He is from India. 就是「他來自印度」。男生用 he。
This is Yuki. She is from Japan.

segs.vis: kid:Yuki；card:She is from Japan.；she；中文 她來自日本。
segs.text: 女生用 she。She is from Japan.「她來自日本。」

segs.text: Repeat after me. She is from Japan.

segs.text: Look at this sentence. She is from India.
Now watch. She and is change places!

segs.vis: card:Is she from India?；swap 完成；Is 發光；問號發光
segs.text: She 和 is 對調，Is 跑到最前面要大寫，句點變問號，就變成問句。
Is she from India?

segs.vis: card:Is she from India?；rise；箭頭動畫；中文 她來自印度嗎？
segs.text: 意思是「她來自印度嗎？」問是不是的問句，句尾要上揚。

segs.vis: card:Is she from India?；rise；she；第 1 輪

segs.text: For a boy, we say he. Is he from India?

segs.text: 問男生就把 she 換成 he。

segs.vis: card:Is he from India?；rise；he；Your turn! 換你唸！

segs.vis: kid:Lily；card:No, she isn't. She's from the UK.；no；中文 不，她不是。她來自英國。
segs.text: Lily 不是從印度來的，所以要說 No, she isn't。接著說出正確答案 She's from the UK。
Look at isn't. Is not... becomes isn't!

segs.vis: card:is not = isn't；merge 完成；撇號發光
segs.text: is not 合在一起，o 拿掉，換成一個小撇號，就變成 isn't。
And She is... becomes She's!
Repeat after me. Is not. Isn't.

segs.vis: card:is not = isn't；Your turn! 換你唸！
card:No, she isn't. She's from the UK.；no；she；第 1 輪

segs.text: Ms. Nova, look at Mia. Is she from Australia?
Yes, she is!

segs.vis: card:Is she ...? → Yes, she is.；back；is 箭頭飛回句尾
segs.text: 答對了就說 Yes, she is.「是的，她是。」問句跑到前面的 Is，回答時又回到 she 後面。

segs.vis: card:Yes, she is.；yes；she is 發光
segs.text: 注意：Yes 的答句要說 she is，不能縮寫成 she's。

segs.text: 問男生就用 he 回答：Yes, he is. 或 No, he isn't. He's from 加國家。

Great! Now let's watch Amy and Ben.

Ben, look at this photo! Is she from Spain?
Yes, she is. She's Sofia.
And is he from Japan?
No, he isn't. He's from Vietnam. He's Nam.
Cool!
Listen again.
